title: India slams Pakistan at UN, says military remains country's 'real rulers'
description:
India strongly hit back at Pakistan's attempts at the UN to paint a "propagandist" picture of New Delhi, saying Islamabad's "Form 47 government" can "dare not" override instructions from the country's real rulers, the Pakistani military.
Form 47 is an official election document in Pakistan that records the provisional, consolidated results of voting in a constituency.
The February 2024 general elections were marred by allegations of rigging and irregularities, with critics using the term "Form 47" to question the official results.
During an interactive dialogue with the Special Rapporteur on Minority Issues at the UN General Assembly's Third Committee on Saturday, First Secretary at the Permanent Mission of India to the UN Raghoo Puri accused Pakistan of attempting to "paint a propagandist picture" of India.
Islamabad's actions, he said, are aimed at diverting attention from its own domestic challenges, including economic distress, lawlessness and human rights violations.
